title: Module Assessment: Decorators & Closures (PY_216 to PY_222)

slides.title: Module 3 Overview
slides.prompt: Assessment covering Closures, Free Variables, Decorator Wrappers, Parameterized Decorators, and functools.wraps.

slides.title: Question 1: Closure Definition
slides.prompt: What is required to form a closure in Python?
options: A nested function referencing free variables from an enclosing scope
A global variable imported inside a function
slides.correctAnswer: A nested function referencing free variables from an enclosing scope

slides.title: Question 2: Nonlocal Keyword
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used inside a closure to rebind variables in the outer non-global scope.

slides.title: Question 3: Preserving Metadata
slides.prompt: Why is `@functools.wraps` applied to a decorator wrapper function?
options: To preserve original name, docstring, and annotations
slides.correctAnswer: To preserve original name, docstring, and annotations

slides.title: Question 4: Inspection of Free Variables
slides.prompt: Which attribute of a function object stores cell objects containing free variables of a closure?

slides.title: Question 6: Decorator Syntax Equivalent
slides.prompt: Fill in the assignment equivalent to `@my_decorator` above `def func(): pass`.

slides.title: Question 6: Parameterized Decorator Layers
slides.prompt: How many nested functions/layers are required to build a decorator that accepts arguments `@dec(arg)`?

slides.title: Question 7: Flexible Arguments
slides.prompt: Fill in positional argument collector inside decorator wrappers to accept any function signature.

slides.title: Question 8: Class Decorator Target
slides.prompt: What does a Class Decorators `@decorator` take as its target argument when placed above `class MyClass:`?

slides.title: Question 9: Stateful Decorator Class
slides.prompt: To create a decorator using a Class instead of a function, which magic method must the class implement?

slides.title: Question 10: Code Object Inspection
slides.prompt: Fill in attribute storing names of free variables inside `func.__code__`.

slides.title: Question 11: Stacking Order
slides.prompt: In what order are stacked decorators `@dec1` then `@dec2` applied to `def f():`?

slides.title: Question 12: Built-in Method Decorators
slides.prompt: Which decorator defines a method that does not receive self or cls as first argument?

slides.title: Question 13: Wraps Import Source
slides.prompt: Fill in the module source for importing `wraps`.

slides.title: Question 14: Unwrapping Decorator
slides.prompt: Which attribute added by `@wraps` allows access to original unwrapped function?
